_what: Per-(model, attack, class_pair) settings an `ours`-base run must match to be comparable to the published `random`-base sweep. Read by ours.sh; every value can be overridden on the command line.
_targets_are_the_point: `targets` is the list of 10 test-set indices the random-base sweep actually attacked, and ours.sh feeds it to final.py via --target_idx_file. Difficulty is NOT used to select them. A degree re-ranks the eligible pool by clean-ensemble p_adv at run time, so it only reproduces the same images if the clean victims are bit-identical -- and they are not: the ResNet20BN/fc/dog-bird tgt10 runs logged `eligible 972` on some invocations and `eligible 974` on others, with p_adv ranges 0.0609..0.0907 vs 0.0326..0.0356. Same seed, same degree, different targets. Pinning the indices removes that failure mode entirely: same 10 images, paired comparison, by construction.
_targets_provenance: The `targets: [...]` line of the random-base run whose numbers table.tex reports, taken from ours_result/<run>/log.txt (identical across all 6 budgets of each sweep, as expected). The 4 ConvNetBN combos have no logs left on disk, so theirs come from the PER-TARGET ASR BREAKDOWN header row of result.txt. For the 8 combos where both sources exist they agree exactly. Only runs with num_targets=10 were used -- several combos also have num_targets=4 side experiments with a different target set.
_difficulty_provenance: The Difficulty column of table.tex, i.e. the --target_select of the run each row reports. Now only a LABEL: it is still passed so the run name keeps its _tgt<N> suffix and lines up with the table, but --target_idx_file takes precedence in final.py (it is checked before the degree branch), so it no longer chooses anything. NOTE ConvNetBN/fc/dog-bird has a second, partial sweep at tgt10 in result.txt -- tgt50 is the one the table reports (ASRs 0.0 1.7 13.3 35.0 73.3 91.7).
_memory_provenance: --craft_lowmem / --fast_gradmatch exactly as used by those same runs. Only VGG13BN+gradmatch used them, and at every budget (0.001..0.04), not just the large ones. --craft_lowmem takes precedence over --fast_gradmatch in final.py, so those runs used the exact objective, just chunked. Ignored when attack=fc.
